segments.text:
Secondly, See that you receive not Christ for a present shift,
but for your everlasting portion: many do so, they will enquire after Christ, pray for Christ, cast themselves (in their way) upon Christ, and the satisfaction of his blood; when the efficacy and terrour of conscience is upon them; and they feel the sting of guilt within them: but assoon as the storm is over, and the rod that conscience shak't over them laid by; there's no more talk of Christ then: alas, it was not Christ but quietness that they sought: beware of mistaking peace for Christ.
